-- 说明：本 SQL 产出 LinkPython 销售订单程序的输入 orders 数组（扁平结构，字段名与用友接口一致）。 -- 表名/列名均为占位，请按 TotalLINK 实际订单表结构调整。 -- 目标输出（每张订单一行主表 + children 由明细子查询提供）： -- ExternalCode / VoucherDate / CustomerCode / Memo / children[] DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30) = '{0}'
SELECT M.EXTERNALCODE AS ExternalCode , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), M.VOUCHERDATE, 120) AS VoucherDate , M.CUSTOMERCODE AS CustomerCode , M.MEMO AS Memo , ( SELECT JSON_QUERY(( SELECT I.INVENTORYCODE AS InventoryCode , U.UNITNAME AS UnitName , D.QUANTITY AS Quantity , CAST(D.ORIGTAXPRICE AS VARCHAR(20)) AS OrigTaxPrice FROM TSALESODETAIL D LEFT JOIN TINVENTORY I ON D.INVENTORYID = I.ID LEFT JOIN TUNIT U ON D.UNITID = U.ID WHERE D.ORDERID = M.ID FOR JSON PATH )) AS children ) AS children FROM TSALESORDER M WHERE M.MFGNUM = @MFGNUM AND M.PUSHSTATUS = 0 -- 待推送 -- AND M.ID = 0{1} -- 可选：按单据筛选
